donorDashboard.title: My monthly donations
donorDashboard.lead: Start a monthly gift, see your recurring donations and cancel whenever you need to.
donorDashboard.empty: You have no monthly donations yet.
donorDashboard.closed: New monthly donations are not available yet.
donorDashboard.amountHelp: Choose an amount from ₹100 to ₹15,000, charged each month for up to 120 months.
donorDashboard.panHelp: Enter the 10-character PAN for your 80G receipts. This is encrypted and never shown publicly.
donorDashboard.indian: This is my own money, paid from India.
donorDashboard.wall: Show my first name and last initial on the donor wall.
donorDashboard.cancelBody: This asks the payment provider to stop future charges immediately. It does not undo previous donations.
donorDashboard.checkoutLead: Authorise this recurring payment with our payment provider. You may cancel from your dashboard at any time.
donorDashboard.adminLead: Review monthly mandates and their current status.
